text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly in the red, with Bitcoin down 0.8% and Ethereum down 0.4%, suggesting modest profit-taking rather than panic selling. The Fear & Greed Index at 51 (neutral) and declining over the past week indicates growing caution, though the $65B daily volume and Bitcoin's sustained 59.4% dominance show the market hasn't lost conviction. Altcoins remain mixed, with BNB flat and SOL dipping more sharply, pointing to selective weakness outside the top two.
